title: crotalaria brachycarpa
intro: Crotalaria brachycarpa, commonly known as Bush Calotrope, is a flowering plant native to India, belonging to the legume family (Fabaceae). The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Crotalaria brachycarpa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
